hashing_procedure.algorithm: SHA256 over raw file bytes for deliverables and source_artifacts.

reproduce: for v in d['deliverables']: print(hashlib.sha256(open(v['path'],'rb').read()).hexdigest(), v['sha256'], v['path'])

hashing_procedure.self_hash_algorithm: SHA256 over the UTF-8 bytes of the canonical JSON serialisation of this document with the self_hash field removed: keys sorted, separators ',' and ':' with no insignificant whitespace, ensure_ascii false, no trailing newline.

nature: Design-only. Research-governance and methodology framework. No candidate, no experiment, no data processing.
no_performance_claim: This manifest records a design-only research-governance and economic-feasibility framework. It contains no P&L, return, expectancy, win rate, drawdown, Sharpe, Sortino, CAGR, equity curve, bootstrap, Monte Carlo, optimisation, backtest, paper-trade or live-trade result. No market-data row was processed. No candidate is shown to be profitable or unprofitable. Historical feasibility failure is not a profitability finding.
